Real transparent alpha background: absolutely no backdrop, dark vignette, glow, floor shadow, border, checkerboard artwork, letters or watermark. Subject: Yelan, adult male scout in his early twenties, lean athletic build, short blue-black hair, sharp gray eyes, composed watchful expression. Dark charcoal and midnight-blue light scout outfit, layered half-cloak, soft leather shoulder guards, subtle muted teal stitching, map case and small practical pouches on belt, dagger held safely point-down at his side. Face visible and no mask, no hood covering hair, agile but understated. Reference is STYLE ONLY; new masculine face and dark scout equipment.
Background constraint: only the character silhouette may have opacity. All surrounding pixels MUST be alpha=0. No colored haze, gradient, blurred studio backdrop or glow behind the head or hands.
